verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state QuickBooks connects to banks, credit cards, PayPal, Square, and imports transactions automatically, with reconciliation reports generated automatically (quickbooks-docs-7, quickbooks-docs-6, quickbooks-docs-8, quickbooks-docs-1). Community evidence corroborates automatic bank rules functioning, though notes some limitations. Missing for 10: independent verification of daily-frequency import cadence and no hands-on confirmation of reliability at scale.
